# Knowledge Base: desargues-theorem-oq-02

Insights accumulated during research on this problem.

---

## Problem Understanding

The problem is to formalize a failure of Desargues's theorem by using the Moulton plane, an affine plane where negative-slope lines bend at the y-axis. The stated target is a concrete six-point configuration: two triangles are perspective from a point O, but their three corresponding side-intersection points are not Moulton-collinear.
